title: Subadditivity of local mass for a difference of currents
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, all sets U, W ⊆ ℝ^P and all currents S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n): M_W(S − T) ≤ M_W(S) + M_W(T) in [0, ∞]. Here S − T is the difference current of the frozen contract, and M_W(R) = sup{ENNReal.ofReal(R(ω)) : ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), tsupport ω ⊆ W, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} (GeometricCurrentOn.massOn with massAdmissibleOn U n W), where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (S - T).massOn W ≤ S.massOn W + T.massOn W
